steps.text: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
I ate, and I actually played for a while
With the controls exactly where they were before?
There is no need to bring that up again
There is a little need
What did you make?
An omelet and a salad
What happened to all the pasta?
I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
That looks good
The dinner or me?
You asked me about the dinner
You are allowed to show initiative
The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
That's better ❤️
Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
No promises on that part
How's your leg after today?
A bit tired, but I didn't push it
I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
Listen to you being reasonable
I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
{{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
The one with the mismatched chairs
Did he seem different when he messaged you?
A little more careful, maybe
Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
You might have surprised him
I definitely surprised myself
I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
I'd have liked to see that
No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
Almost certainly
The strange part is that I already know him
Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
That's the part you're curious about?
Yes, I think it is
I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
Good choice
And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
Have you been talking much this evening?
A little before dinner
Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
How did he take that?
Like a normal person who also has things to do
It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
Do you think you'll get along in person?
I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
You already have someone who does the last one
Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
They are
See? Completely unreasonable 😌
I like that there are things I don't know yet
Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
Okay, your turn
My turn for what?
What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
Not the very supportive answer, the first one

options.text: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real

steps.text: That quickly?
Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
You could have just said that
I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
I still want to hear your reaction
I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
I did
And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
Real in a bad way?
Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
I know
And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
Then that's what you'll get ❤️
I like talking to you like this
Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
Especially then
Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
I'm waiting for an opening
Predictable man
Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
For tomorrow?
Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
Show me
Give me a minute
6 MINUTES LATER
This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
I like it
You answered very quickly
Would you prefer a slower compliment?
I'd prefer one I believe
You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
That's actually exactly what I wanted
And you look beautiful
That part helps too 😌
I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
A very practical fashion decision
I contain multitudes
I'm keeping the outfit, then
And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
I like getting the preview
Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
A shame I missed that part
This one is just between us, by the way
I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
I can live with that
Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
That still sounds right to me
Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
Something else happened while I was trying this on
What?
I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
I like that you wanted both
So do I, actually
I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
I'm glad you did
Me too ❤️
And our film afternoon is still happening
I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
I'd let you in without it
I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
You agreed I could choose
I remember
Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
You're never letting that go, are you
Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
Nobody knows, that's part of the film
Terrible system
Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
8 MINUTES LATER
Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
Not even me?
You can have a small exception
I like this version too
Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
As long as I get to sit beside you
That's rather the point ❤️
I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
Good night, pretty girl
Good night, handsome
And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
There she is
I never left 😌
